    def get_image_mimetype(self) -> str | None:
        """Get the image's mimetype, guessing it if it has not been set yet.

        The mimetype is resolved lazily on first access: if it is not set,
        it is guessed from the image data using the filetype library and
        cached on the block, so subsequent calls return the cached value
        without re-resolving it.

        Returns:
            The image's mimetype, or None if it cannot be determined.
        """
        if self.image_mimetype is None and self.image is not None:
            guess = filetype.guess(self.image)
            self.image_mimetype = guess.mime if guess else None

        return self.image_mimetype

import sys, base64
sys.path.insert(0, '/scratch/manas_ase/tmp/parbench-host-zistj10m/repo/llama-index-core')
from unittest import mock
from llama_index.core.base.llms.types import ImageBlock

png_1px_b64 = b"iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8z8BQDwAEhQGAhKmMIQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=="
png_1px = base64.b64decode(png_1px_b64)

# 1. guess + cache via accessor
b = ImageBlock(image=png_1px)
assert b.get_image_mimetype() == "image/png", b.get_image_mimetype()
assert b.image_mimetype == "image/png"

# 2. caching: no re-guess on second call
with mock.patch("llama_index.core.base.llms.types.filetype.guess") as g:
    assert b.get_image_mimetype() == "image/png"
    g.assert_not_called()

# 3. explicit mimetype is not overridden
b2 = ImageBlock(image=png_1px, image_mimetype="image/jpeg")
assert b2.get_image_mimetype() == "image/jpeg"
assert b2.image_mimetype == "image/jpeg"

# 4. lazy: raw bytes assigned after construction (validator not re-run)
b3 = ImageBlock()
b3.image = png_1px
assert b3.get_image_mimetype() == "image/png"
assert b3.image_mimetype == "image/png"
with mock.patch("llama_index.core.base.llms.types.filetype.guess") as g:
    assert b3.get_image_mimetype() == "image/png"
    g.assert_not_called()

# 5. no image data -> None
b4 = ImageBlock()
assert b4.get_image_mimetype() is None

# 6. unrecognizable bytes -> None
b5 = ImageBlock(image=b"not an image at all")
assert b5.get_image_mimetype() is None

# 7. base64 encoding still happens, resolve_image still works
assert b.image == png_1px_b64
assert b.resolve_image().read() == png_1px

# 8. validator still sets mimetype eagerly (back-compat)
b6 = ImageBlock(image=png_1px)
assert b6.image_mimetype == "image/png"

# 9. path/url blocks: no guessing from unloaded resources
b7 = ImageBlock(url="http://example.com")
assert b7.get_image_mimetype() is None

print("ALL SANITY CHECKS PASSED")
